## [1] goal
- Checkpoint request: the team is about to be restarted. Commit your work on your own branch as `wip(resume): <your open request's slug, or idle>`, with these lines in the body: `Request: <open request id or none>`, `Where: <one line>`, `Next: <one line>`, `Processes: <stopped: … | none>` and, if useful, `Notes:`. `git add` your own files only, untracked work you need included. Do not push. If a commit is impossible (a merge or rebase is in progress), answer not-ready.
- Stop every background process you started (headless Godot runs, servers, watchers) and name them in `Processes:`.
- Reply `Checkpoint: ready branch=<branch> sha=<sha> inflight=none` only after that, or `Checkpoint: not-ready reason=<one line>`. Put the line first under `## [1] status` of your response.
- Then stop working until you are resumed; a new instruction supersedes this.
